source_findings.detail: The trained builder uses common_outlet_axis.build and actual terminal pooling arguments. All six local training/frozen artifact schemas match the requested run paths, dataset MSVR310, seed42, pooling and variant; each training result is COMPLETE at 50 epochs with exit code zero.

MethodType wrappers retain original bound forward/read/fuse methods. Auxiliary captures clear per forward; projection captures clear before calling the unchanged production fuse. Each hook only detaches its original output and does not replace it. Captures retain at most the current/previous batch until replacement; no history is accumulated.

M_aux/F_aux use the first unconditioned m0/f0 reads from the same available inputs and the exact existing auxiliary-loss pooling formulas in shared_identity_axis.py:205-206. The additional pool calls contain no stateful layers or randomness and return the unchanged read result to production.

Original_mean preserves flattened residual multiplication, M+I before mean7, and shared+(df+mi). Eligible_mean/seed_query preserve the production relationwise residual sum, actual captured outlet coefficients, then summation and shared+(df+mi). The original fuse and reconstruction explicitly use FP32 with autocast disabled. Runtime equality is asserted and remains unexecuted in this review.

M_pre/M_post retain the same mass, anchors, eligible mask and actual trained aggregation; F_pre/F_post differ only by PF. The unchanged extractor normalizes all stages; seven stages are512D and deployment is5632D. Source-identical auxiliary comparison includes conditioning/routing/aggregation and is not a causal routing effect.

The reused framework strictly loads the best checkpoint, sets every module to eval, extracts under torch.no_grad, checks state tensor versions, and has no optimizer/checkpoint writes. Full runs assert exact saved RNT features and all49 previous deployment six metrics/per-query CSVs, then recheck sizes and hashes of the five protected input artifacts. M1 metadata replaces the obsolete V12 labels.

Installed training filenames and fixed dev IDs generate the GT; ordering agrees with the actual MSVR loader. Independent lexicographic distance/gallery-row ranking applies same-ID/same-scene filtering. All six metrics, CMC1..50, query/valid/gallery counts, complete identity/camera/scene groups and every per-query field are checked against the actual producer schema. This audit has not been run for the new diagnostic.

Final code checks exact relation eligibility, finite nonnegative anchors/masses/coefficients, route mass sum1, illegal-support zeros, mean coefficients per relation, query coefficient simplex, weighted_anchor, weighted_anchor_readout and readout/shared norm using FP32 tolerances. Query logits are not exported; no independent recomputation of seed_query softmax is claimed.

One serial axis queue uses physicalGPU2; one serial frequency queue uses physicalGPU3. Two workers maximum. The first executor must complete all six smokes before full tasks are submitted. Successful and failing barrier paths passed standard-library mocks.

It requires PASS/no blockers/current3/current57/its own reviewed hash. It verifies the old57 and copies/verifies only the new3 on2025/2026/2027. Predeployment executes AST/stdlib checks and the stdlib selected-GPU memory helper only. A single controller Popen on2026 uses existing conda and exclusive output/log paths. There are no thermal, power or administrator gates, environment rebuilds, neural calls on2025/2027, or retries.

scalar_actual_loop_AST.numpy_isclose_substitution: Standard-library scalar abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(b); NumPy was not imported. This checks isolated logic and is not a completed NumPy/GT audit.
